description:
Show the user code in the chat, with a button that copies it. Use it for code the user will copy and use: a command to run, a file to save, a snippet to paste. It only displays the code: it runs nothing and changes no files. The user sees it with syntax colours, so don't repeat it in your reply. For a line or two inside an explanation, a Markdown code block is enough.

Give `language` for syntax colours, such as rust or bash. Limits: 10,000 lines and 512 KiB.

code.description: The code, exactly as the user should copy it.

language.description: The language for syntax colours, such as rust or bash.

title.description: A short heading, such as what the code does.

name: show_code
